description: Lists every filter of the catalog search with counts: categories (home and also-in), tags, and countries a utility is specific to. Each item has its id (category and tag ids, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes), its name in the page language and its number of utilities; `everywhere` counts utilities that are not specific to any country. Use the ids with catalog_search_utilities.
name: catalog_list_facets
title: List categories and tags
